name: claude-fluency-toolkit
description: Reusable Claude Code plugins for AI-assisted engineering workflows: principles + safety hooks, a security-scan agent fleet, Azure DevOps companion skills, document generation, and timesheet generation.

plugins.name: dev-workflow-toolkit
plugins.description: Engineering principles, safety hooks, and commit/PR/learning commands.

plugins.name: security-scan-toolkit
plugins.description: A 10-agent security audit fleet orchestrated by /security-scan.

plugins.name: devops-companion
plugins.description: Knowledge-graph and Azure DevOps PR review/comment skills.

plugins.name: doc-generation-toolkit
plugins.description: Generate Minutes of Meeting via /mom and PowerPoint decks via /create-pptx from source documents.

plugins.name: timesheet-toolkit
plugins.description: Generate daily timesheet entries from git history and file timestamps across your configured repos via /timesheet.
